meta.title: Pricing — ReplyLo
meta.description: Simple prepaid pricing for ReplyLo. Pick replies per post, keep your Instagram auto-replies running for 30 days. No auto-renewal.

pricing.title: Simple prepaid pricing
pricing.sub: Buy a pass, pick your replies-per-post allowance, run for 30 days. No subscriptions, no auto-renewal — you top up when you need to.
pricing.viralBody: Add {replies} extra replies to any single post for {price}. Only that post's cap goes up — nothing else changes.
pricing.count1: Each post you run gets its own reply allowance (e.g. 100 on Growth). When one post's replies hit its cap, only that post pauses — your other posts keep replying.
pricing.count2: A pass covers up to 15 different posts in a 30-day period. Counters reset when your period renews, so a post that used everything gets a fresh allowance.
pricing.count3: If a reply can't be delivered, the unit is refunded automatically. You only pay for replies that actually reach the commenter.
pricing.pricesNote: All prices in INR, inclusive of applicable taxes. Passes never auto-renew — see our terms.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.collectBody: When you use ReplyLo we store: your email address and a salted password hash (we never store your password itself), your Instagram account's public username, and an Instagram access token (encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM). When your keyword rules run we store the commenter's public user ID, the comment ID, the text of any DM reply they send us, and any email address they voluntarily send in a DM.
privacy.analyticsBody: We run our own first-party visit counter on this website (page path, referrer, and a truncated SHA-256 hash of your user-agent). No cookies are set for analytics and no third-party analytics vendors are used.
privacy.useBody: Only to run the auto-reply you configured: matching comment keywords, sending the DM you wrote, and showing you dashboards of what happened. We do not sell data, and we do not use your comment or DM content to train anything.
privacy.metaBody: We access Instagram data through Meta's official Graph APIs with the permissions you grant during "Connect Instagram". You can revoke access at any time from your Instagram settings; Meta will notify us and we delete the stored token immediately.
privacy.retentionPre: You can delete everything at any time with the "Delete my account" button in your dashboard — this erases your login, connected accounts, rules, conversations and emails. Commenters can request deletion of their data via the
privacy.retentionPost: . Nightly database backups are rotated and expire within 7 days.
privacy.securityBody: Traffic is served over HTTPS. Session cookies are HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax and Secure. Instagram tokens are encrypted at rest. Passwords are hashed with scrypt.
privacy.contactPre: Questions or deletion requests: email the address shown on the
privacy.controllerBody: The data controller for the personal data described in this policy is the company that operates ReplyLo (TODO: legal entity name, registered address, and country). For any privacy request you can also write to the contact address on the data deletion page.
privacy.processorsBody: We share data only with the processors needed to run the service: Meta Platforms (Instagram API — comments and direct messages), our hosting provider (the server and disk where our database lives), and our payment providers (Razorpay for payments in INR, Dodo Payments for other currencies). Payment providers see your order and payment details; they never see your Instagram data.
privacy.storageBody: Your account, encrypted Instagram tokens, rules and conversation history are stored in a single database on our hosting provider's server (TODO: hosting region). Nightly backups stay with the same provider and expire within 7 days.
privacy.rightsBody: You can export or erase your data at any time: use "Delete my account" in your dashboard for immediate erasure, or send us a written request. We respond to access, export and deletion requests within 30 days.
privacy.bindingBody: This policy is offered in several languages for convenience. The English version is the legally binding one.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.serviceBody: ReplyLo automates replies to Instagram comments and sends direct messages on your behalf, using Meta's official APIs and the permissions you grant. We provide the software "as is" and aim for high availability but do not guarantee uninterrupted service.
terms.respBody: You must follow the Instagram Platform Terms and Community Guidelines with the content you automate. Do not use ReplyLo for spam, scams, or messaging people who did not request it. You are responsible for the DM text and links you configure. Accounts that abuse Meta's messaging limits may be suspended by Meta or by us.
terms.plansBody: ReplyLo uses prepaid passes. Each pass (Starter, Growth or Pro) lasts 30 days and gives you a reply allowance per post (50, 100 or 250 replies) across up to 15 posts per period. The free plan includes 1 connected account, 3 keyword rules, 20 replies per post and 2 posts per 30-day period. Trials use Growth limits until they expire. If a reply cannot be delivered, the unit is refunded automatically. You can add 100 extra replies to any single post with a top-up.
terms.refundsPre: Passes and top-ups are prepaid and
terms.refundsPost: — when a pass expires your account drops to the free limits until you choose to buy again. Passes are non-refundable once activated, except where required by law; if a billing error charges you twice for the same order we will refund the duplicate in full. Top-ups applied to a post are consumed as replies are sent and are non-refundable. Unused replies do not carry over after your 30-day period ends. If you believe a charge was wrong, contact us and we will make it right.
terms.availBody: ReplyLo depends on Meta's APIs. Rate limits, permission reviews, or API changes on Meta's side can affect delivery. Where Meta blocks a message, we cannot force it through.
terms.termBody: You can delete your account and all associated data at any time from the dashboard. We may suspend accounts that violate these terms or Meta's platform policies.
terms.liabilityBody: To the maximum extent permitted by law, our total liability is limited to the amount you paid us in the 12 months before the claim, and we are not liable for lost profits or for actions taken by Meta on your account.
terms.controllerBody: These terms are agreed with the company that operates ReplyLo (TODO: legal entity name, registered address, and country). If you use the service from another country, you agree to these terms with that entity.
terms.dataStoredBody: While using the service you keep on our systems: your account (email and password hash), your connected Instagram account and its access token (encrypted at rest), the keyword rules and DM text you configure, and the record of comments, replies and emails your automation processed. This data is used only to run your automation.
terms.processorsBody: Running the service involves Meta Platforms (Instagram API for comments and DMs), our hosting provider (server and database storage), and our payment providers (Razorpay for payments in INR, Dodo Payments for other currencies). Each processes only what it needs; payment providers never see your Instagram data.
terms.storageBody: All application data is stored on our hosting provider's server (TODO: hosting region). If your country requires data to stay in a specific region, contact us before relying on the service.
terms.rightsBody: You can export or erase your data at any time: "Delete my account" in the dashboard erases everything immediately, and people who received DMs from your account can use the data deletion page. We answer written requests within 30 days.
terms.retentionBody: We keep your data while your account is active. After you delete your account the data is erased immediately and disappears from nightly backups within 7 days. Comment and DM records are kept until you (or the commenter) request deletion.
terms.bindingBody: These terms are offered in several languages for convenience. The English version is the legally binding one.

dataDeletion.title: Data deletion
dataDeletion.sub: How to get your data removed from ReplyLo — permanently, usually within 24 hours.
dataDeletion.s2: 2. I got a DM from a ReplyLo-powered account
dataDeletion.s1Post: (top right). You'll confirm with your password, and we immediately erase your login, connected Instagram accounts and access token, all keyword rules, conversations, collected emails and sessions. Nothing is kept except anonymised visit counters.
dataDeletion.s2Body: We store the commenter ID, comment ID and any message you replied with for that business account. To have it removed, reply to the business's DM asking them to delete it, or email us with the Instagram handle of the account that messaged you and we'll remove the associated rows for you.
dataDeletion.s3Body: If you revoke ReplyLo's permissions in Instagram settings, or delete your Instagram account, Meta calls our data-deletion / deauthorize endpoints and we drop the stored access token and any data tied to your user id right away.
dataDeletion.contactPost: with the Instagram handle or email address involved. We confirm once deletion is complete.
